items.title: 67251_Chuck Green oral history interview
items.q: And then there was Step'n'Fetchit. Of course you know about Step'n'Fetchit. He's an old man considered a legend now.

ctx.x: So, what sort of things were happening at the Hoofer's Club?

Oh, well, I mean they eventually acquired Dancing Dodson. That's where he come from. He was acquired from there. He went on to be like -- he was considered like the Chocolate Harry Richman, see. He was a jazz singer and dancer. He was a dancer -- the popular dance in those times was the Strut, you know, what you called showing your figure, you know, your build, your masculinity, or whatever, you know, and that's what he -- he was one of the best at the Hoofer's Club, and then there was King Rastus. He was turned…
